verdict.rationale: Mangopay's wallet model gives the platform per-user wallets and a documented flow to receive, hold, split and transfer funds, then pay out to bank accounts. Platform fees are collected and wired out monthly, and webhooks expose events on API objects. This supports seller-level balances and a charge→split→payout structure in principle, but the pack never shows how a finance lead would see balances, trace movements end to end, or reconcile. missing for 10: explicit per-wallet balance and fee-wallet visibility, end-to-end transaction traceability linking pay-in to transfer to payout, reconciliation reports/exports to the penny, independent or hands-on corroboration.
